entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 978086481343568128: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 28.0525 +/- 0.0242 mas (same row, RUWE 1.14): 35.65 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -92.924, -570.393 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.539 +/- 0.014 solar radii from Wilson et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of LHS 1903 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026Sci...392l2348W/abstract). Mass 0.538 +/- 0.039 solar masses from Wilson et al. 2026, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of LHS 1903 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026Sci...392l2348W/abstract). Temperature 3664 +/- 70 K from Wilson et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of LHS 1903 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 3,664 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffcb94. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 3,664 K and log g 4.71 (u1 0.403, u2 0.356): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
